steps.title: JOIN и NULL в связях
steps.content:
## JOIN

- **`INNER JOIN`** — только совпадения.
- **`LEFT JOIN`** — все строки слева; нет пары → NULL справа.
- Сравнение дат: `DATE(col, "+1 day")` в SQLite.

content.caption: LEFT JOIN сохраняет левую таблицу
content.description: Для «никогда не …» часто LEFT JOIN + `IS NULL`.

steps.title: 1378. Replace Employee ID With The Unique Identifier

content.description:
Свяжите `Employees` и `EmployeeUNI` по `id`. Верните `unique_id` и `name`; если unique_id нет — NULL.

[LeetCode 1378](https://leetcode.com/problems/replace-employee-id-with-the-unique-identifier/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Employees(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE EmployeeUNI(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, unique_id INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT e.id AS unique_id, e.name FROM Employees e INNER JOIN EmployeeUNI u ON e.id = u.id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT u.unique_id, e.name FROM Employees e LEFT JOIN EmployeeUNI u ON e.id = u.id;

tests.seed:
INSERT INTO Employees VALUES (1,'Alice'),(7,'Bob'),(11,'Meir'),(90,'Winston'),(3,'Jonathan');
INSERT INTO EmployeeUNI VALUES (3,1),(11,2),(90,3);
INSERT INTO Employees VALUES (1,'A');

INSERT INTO Employees VALUES (1,'A');
INSERT INTO EmployeeUNI VALUES (1,10);

content.description:
Клиенты, которые **ни разу** не делали заказ. Колонка результата: `Customers` (имя).

[LeetCode 1581](https://leetcode.com/problems/customer-who-never-order/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Customers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customerId INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT name AS Customers FROM Customers;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT c.name AS Customers FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON c.id = o.customerId WHERE o.customerId IS NULL;

tests.seed:
INSERT INTO Customers VALUES (1,'Joe'),(2,'Henry'),(3,'Sam'),(4,'Max');
INSERT INTO Orders VALUES (1,3),(2,1);
INSERT INTO Customers VALUES (1,'A');

INSERT INTO Customers VALUES (1,'A');
INSERT INTO Orders VALUES (1,1);

content.description:
Для каждой продажи: `product_name`, `year`, `price` (название из `Product`, год и цена из `Sales`).

[LeetCode 1068](https://leetcode.com/problems/product-sales-analysis-i/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Sales(sale_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, year INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, price INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Product(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_name TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, year, price FROM Sales;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT p.product_name, s.year, s.price FROM Sales s JOIN Product p ON s.product_id = p.product_id;

content.description:
Средний `experience_years` по каждому `project_id`, округлённый до **2** знаков, колонка `average_years`.

[LeetCode 1075](https://leetcode.com/problems/project-employees-i/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Project(project_id INTEGER NOT NULL, employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project_id, employee_id));
CREATE TABLE Employee(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, experience_years INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT project_id, AVG(experience_years) AS average_years FROM Employee GROUP BY project_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT p.project_id, ROUND(AVG(e.experience_years), 2) AS average_years FROM Project p JOIN Employee e ON p.employee_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY p.project_id;

INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (1,"Khaled",3),(2,"Ali",2),(3,"John",1),(4,"Doe",2);

INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (1,"A",5);

content.description:
Id записей, где температура **строго выше**, чем в **предыдущий календарный день** (`recordDate`).

[LeetCode 197](https://leetcode.com/problems/rising-temperature/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Weather(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, recordDate TEXT NOT NULL, temperature INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT id FROM Weather ORDER BY recordDate;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT w1.id FROM Weather w1 JOIN Weather w2 ON w1.recordDate = DATE(w2.recordDate, "+1 day") WHERE w1.temperature > w2.temperature;

tests.seed: INSERT INTO Weather VALUES (1,"2015-01-01",10);

content.description:
Имена сотрудников с `bonus < 1000` (или bonus NULL). Колонки: `Employee`, `Bonus`.

[LeetCode 577](https://leetcode.com/problems/employee-bonus/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Employee(empId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, supervisor INTEGER, salary INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Bonus(empId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, bonus INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT name AS Employee, bonus AS Bonus FROM Employee JOIN Bonus USING(empId);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT e.name AS Employee, b.bonus AS Bonus FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Bonus b ON e.empId = b.empId WHERE b.bonus < 1000 OR b.bonus IS NULL;

INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (3,"Brad",NULL,4000),(1,"John",3,1000),(2,"Dan",3,2000),(4,"Thomas",3,4000);
INSERT INTO Bonus VALUES (2,500),(4,2000);
INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (1,"A",NULL,1);

INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (1,"Rich",NULL,1);
INSERT INTO Bonus VALUES (1,5000);

steps.title: 570. Managers with at Least 5 Direct Reports

content.description:
Имена менеджеров, у которых **≥ 5** прямых подчинённых (`managerId`).

[LeetCode 570](https://leetcode.com/problems/managers-with-at-least-5-direct-reports/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employee(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, department TEXT, managerId INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT name FROM Employee WHERE id IN (SELECT managerId FROM Employee);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT name FROM Employee WHERE id IN (SELECT managerId FROM Employee GROUP BY managerId HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5);

tests.seed: INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (1,"M",NULL,NULL),(2,"A","X",1),(3,"B","X",1);
INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (1,"Boss",NULL,NULL),(2,"A","X",1),(3,"B","X",1),(4,"C","X",1),(5,"D","X",1);

content.description:
Для каждой пары студент × предмет выведите `student_id`, `student_name`, `subject_name` и `attended_exams` — сколько раз студент сдавал экзамен по этому предмету (0, если не сдавал). Сортировка: `student_id`, затем `subject_name`.

[LeetCode 1280](https://leetcode.com/problems/students-and-examinations/)
content.starterCode: SELECT student_id, student_name, subject_name, COUNT(*) AS attended_exams FROM Examinations GROUP BY student_id, subject_name;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name, COUNT(e.student_id) AS attended_exams FROM Students s CROSS JOIN Subjects sub LEFT JOIN Examinations e ON s.student_id = e.student_id AND sub.subject_name = e.subject_name GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name ORDER BY s.student_id, sub.subject_name;

tests.seed:
INSERT INTO Students VALUES (1,'Ann');
INSERT INTO Subjects VALUES ('Bio');

content.description:
Для каждого `user_id` — `confirmation_rate`: доля `confirmed` среди **timeout** и **confirmed** (rounded to 2 decimals). Нет таких действий → `0.00`.

[LeetCode 1934](https://leetcode.com/problems/confirmation-rate/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Signups(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, time_stamp TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Confirmations(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, time_stamp TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, 1.0 AS confirmation_rate FROM Signups;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT s.user_id, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(c.action = "confirmed") * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(c.action IN ("confirmed","timeout")), 0), 0), 2) AS confirmation_rate FROM Signups s LEFT JOIN Confirmations c ON s.user_id = c.user_id GROUP BY s.user_id;

tests.seed:
INSERT INTO Signups VALUES (1,"2020-01-01");
INSERT INTO Confirmations VALUES (1,"2020-01-02","confirmed");

INSERT INTO Signups VALUES (1,"2020-01-01");
INSERT INTO Confirmations VALUES (1,"2020-01-02","timeout");
